doc:
(** srv32 D step and final theorem: the generic pipeline obligation skeleton (CPUPipelineObligations) with
    [Runtime = RTL state + ghost cycle counter], no post-fetch stages, the joint INV [Inv] = boot B0 | B1 | B2 | operating
    [Srv32TmplRun.Op] (pulse states S0..S3), the commit condition = the target observer's own [committing] bit (n >= 3 and
    ex_flush = 0), token = ex_pc, rank = [Srv32TmplTarget.st_rank] (boot 6-n, pulse countdown 2,1,0).  The junk slots S1/S2 are
    silent operating cycles ([Srv32TmplRun.op_silent]).  Final: from the real reset, the RTL ITree refines the ISA ITree for every
    program of the 29-class jump-family domain [CPUJumpFamilyProgramDomain.check_program].
    proof_author: LLM-generated: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5); external_llm_api_calls=0. *)

names: EX (token = ex_pc; WB write pending in the register relation)

valid.meaning: n >= 3 (ghost counter) and ex_flush (272) = 0 on the boundary state

pending_view.note: ISA reg r = lane r-1 overwritten by the pending WB write (wb_alu2reg & !wb_flush, wb_dst_sel = r); lane 31 = dead cell of x0 writes

front.cursor: S0/S3: ex_pc = pc, if_pc = pc+4, fetch_pc = pc+8, imem_rdata = rom(if_pc), EX regs = decode(rom(pc)); S1: fetch_pc = pc; S2: if_pc = pc, fetch_pc = pc+4, imem_rdata = rom(pc)

boot.method: non-interference (Lang.ExtendedSVNonInterference): concrete run with ROM = 0, taint sets t1..t11; tainted registers by fetch/capture lemmas

operating.step_shape: commit: exists y index', run1 f = (Some tt, y) /\ token = pc f /\ Op (cycle s) y index'; silent: Op (cycle s) f index /\ rank decreases

rank.meaning: boot: 6 - n; operating: min 2 (S1 = 2, S2 = 1, S0/S3 = 0)
